title: kb/_self/monitoring.md still says the items of a sprint share the trace of the kb.sprint root span, while each kb.item has its own trace
goal: the Spans paragraph of kb/_self/monitoring.md says each kb.item span has a trace of its own and how the kb.sprint root span relates to it, as mon_events exports them

run:
import re, sys
t = open("kb/_self/monitoring.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
p = next((l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith("- **Spans.**")), "")
stale = bool(re.search(r"items of a sprint share the trace|share the trace of its `kb.sprint`", p))
own = bool(re.search(r"trace of (its|their) own|its own trace|their own traces?|own trace", p))
parent = bool(re.search(r"kb\.sprint[^.]*\bparent|\bparent[^.]*kb\.sprint", p))
print("Spans paragraph found:", bool(p), "| still says the items share the sprint trace:", stale, "| says a kb.item has a trace of its own:", own, "| says the kb.sprint span is the parent of a kb.item:", parent)
sys.exit(0 if p and not stale and own and parent else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is a sentence of a doc that disagrees with the exported spans; the repro reads the sentence
